input.plan:
# Fix kuchup.com PageSpeed (mobile 85)

Source: [PageSpeed Insights report](https://pagespeed.web.dev/analysis/https-kuchup-com/q07yi3cb2g?utm_source=search_console&form_factor=mobile&hl=en_GB) captured 7 Sept 2026. URL is the marketing homepage only. No CrUX field data yet.

## What the report actually says

| | Mobile | Desktop |
|---|---|---|
| Performance | **85** | **99** |
| Accessibility | 96 | 96 |
| Best Practices / SEO | 100 | 100 |
| Agentic browsing | 2/3 | 2/3 |

Mobile lab metrics (Moto G Power, Slow 4G):

- **FCP 2.6s**, **LCP 3.1s**, **Speed Index 4.8s** — these three are why the score is orange
- TBT 180ms (fine), CLS 0 (fine)
- Server TTFB is already good (27ms). This is not an EC2/Flask latency problem.

Desktop is 0.7s FCP/LCP — same page, same HTML. The work is the **mobile critical path**, not a rewrite.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  html[HTML kuchup.com]
  css[Next CSS 0e77e3ec]
  gcss["fonts.googleapis.com Lexend CSS"]
  woff[Lexend woff2]
  manrope[Self-hosted Manrope woff2]
  html --> css
  html --> gcss
  gcss --> woff
  html --> manrope
```

Manrope and JetBrains Mono are already self-hosted via `next/font`. **Lexend is not** — it goes through Google, and that chain is the 1,130ms render-blocking estimate.

## Failures mapped to code

**1. Render-blocking + third-party + network tree (biggest score move)**

[`homepage/app/layout.tsx`](homepage/app/layout.tsx) loads Lexend as a classic stylesheet:

```123:126:homepage/app/layout.tsx
        <link
          href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lexend:wght@500;600;700&display=swap"
          rel="stylesheet"
        />
```

The exported [`relocation_jobs/static/homepage/index.html`](relocation_jobs/static/homepage/index.html) also render-blocks on `/_next/static/css/0e77e3ecaf398228.css`. That CSS stays; the Google hop should go away.

**Fix:** load Lexend with `next/font/google` the same way Manrope is loaded (`display: "swap"`, CSS variable `--font-display`). Remove the Google `<link>`s. Update `--font-display` in [`homepage/app/design-tokens.css`](homepage/app/design-tokens.css) to use the Next variable.

**2. LCP element starts invisible**

Hero H1 uses `hero-enter` + `animation-fill-mode: both`, which applies `opacity: 0` before the animation runs ([`homepage/app/globals.css`](homepage/app/globals.css) ~391–416, [`homepage/components/Hero.tsx`](homepage/components/Hero.tsx)). On a 3.1s LCP that is free delay.

**Fix:** do not animate opacity on the H1 (kicker/lede can still fade). Prefer transform-only, or no entrance animation on the LCP node.

**3. Contrast (Accessibility 96)**

Lighthouse failing nodes: `.section-kicker`, `.journey-number`, `.product-source`, `.access-label`, `.prepare-evidence span`, workflow `01`–`04` spans.

- Kickers/labels: `--color-accent-deep` `#d94f1f` on `--color-paper` / `--color-paper-2` — orange at 11px fails 4.5:1
- `.journey-number`: `--color-rule` `#a9c1d1` on paper — decorative grey, ~2:1

**Fix:** add a text-only token (e.g. `--color-accent-text`) that meets AA on paper and paper-2; keep button orange unchanged. Darken `.journey-number` to a navy at reduced visual weight (still ≥4.5:1), or `aria-hidden` **and** a passing color (Lighthouse still flags visible text).

**4. `llms.txt` (Agentic browsing 2/3)**

Error: *File does not appear to contain any links.* [`relocation_jobs/static/llms.txt`](relocation_jobs/static/llms.txt) has an H1 and bare URLs. The audit wants Markdown `[label](url)` links. Convert the canonical-pages list and product bullets. Extend the existing assertion in [`tests/web/test_public_api.py`](tests/web/test_public_api.py).

**5. Legacy / unused JS (~11–21 KiB) and long tasks**

`…chunks/255-*.js` and `4bd1b696-*.js` are Next/React runtime, not landing copy. Homepage client islands: Header (layout), Hero, SearchBar, SearchResults, AuthCta.

- Add a modern `browserslist` in [`homepage/package.json`](homepage/package.json) so SWC drops legacy polyfills
- Narrow [`SearchFlowProvider`](homepage/components/SearchFlowContext.tsx) to wrap only Hero + SearchResults in [`homepage/app/page.tsx`](homepage/app/page.tsx), not the whole page
- Split Hero: server-rendered copy + client `SearchBar` island so the H1 is not a client component
- Delete unused [`homepage/hooks/useInView.ts`](homepage/hooks/useInView.ts) (dead; `getBoundingClientRect` in `useLayoutEffect` is a reflow footgun if it comes back)

Do **not** try to eliminate the React runtime. 21 KiB unused on a static marketing page is not the 3.1s LCP.

**6. CSS weight / DOM size (diminishing returns)**

[`homepage/app/globals.css`](homepage/app/globals.css) (~2.5k lines) is imported from the root layout, so every marketing route pays for homepage journey/mock styles.

- Move homepage-only blocks (hero, journey/product-frame, access, FAQ) into something like `homepage/app/home.css` imported from [`homepage/app/page.tsx`](homepage/app/page.tsx) only
- Keep tokens + nav/footer/shared bands in the layout CSS
- DOM: keep the product mocks; they are not 1.4k-node territory. If a post-fix Lighthouse run still flags DOM, flatten the mock frames (fewer nested wrappers), don’t gut the page

Forced-reflow / LCP-breakdown / third-party insights should collapse once Lexend is self-hosted and the H1 is visible.

## Out of scope

- Flask/EC2 caching and TTFB (already passing)
- Job pages / panel (this report is `/` only)
- Chasing a 100 mobile score
- Deploy — rebuild static export locally; deploy only if you ask

## Verify

1. `cd homepage && npm run build:flask`
2. `pytest tests/web/test_public_api.py -o addopts= -q --tb=line`
3. Spot-check `/` HTML: no `fonts.googleapis.com`, Lexend woff2 preloaded like Manrope
4. Contrast: kickers and journey numbers on paper and sky bands
5. After deploy: re-run PSI mobile; target **Performance ≥ 90**, Accessibility 100, Agentic 3/3

# Kuchup (Relocation Jobs)

> Curated visa-sponsored software engineering roles across Europe, with application tracking and Claude/Cursor MCP for CV prep.

## Product

- [Public preview search](https://kuchup.com/) (no sign-in)
- Country guides for [Germany](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-germany), the [Netherlands](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-netherlands), the [UK](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-uk), [Portugal](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-portugal), and [Ireland](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-ireland)
- Full board and company workspaces behind sign-in (not for indexing)
- [MCP server](https://kuchup.com/mcp) for gated CV reframe — you submit applications yourself

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://kuchup.com/)
- [How it works](https://kuchup.com/how-it-works)
- [Pricing](https://kuchup.com/pricing)
- [MCP](https://kuchup.com/mcp)
- [Engineering](https://kuchup.com/engineering)
- [One loop is not faster](https://kuchup.com/engineering/one-loop-not-faster)
- [Can't start a new thread](https://kuchup.com/engineering/cant-start-new-thread)
- [678 Postgres round trips](https://kuchup.com/engineering/678-postgres-round-trips)
- [Cache check in the hot path](https://kuchup.com/engineering/cache-check-in-the-hot-path)
- [Playwright hung for 15 hours](https://kuchup.com/engineering/playwright-hung-for-15-hours)
- [Relocation jobs in Germany](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-germany)
- [Relocation jobs in the Netherlands](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-netherlands)
- [Relocation jobs in the UK](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-uk)
- [Relocation jobs in Portugal](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-portugal)
- [Relocation jobs in Ireland](https://kuchup.com/relocation-jobs-ireland)

## Notes

- Catalog refreshes from company career pages about every six hours
- Sponsorship signals are heuristics; always confirm the live job description
- Private app surfaces (`/panel`, `/apply`, `/api/`) are disallowed in [robots.txt](https://kuchup.com/robots.txt); `/api/public/` is allowed

## Optional

- [GitHub](https://github.com/AminMortezaie/relocation-jobs)

Mobile PageSpeed was 85 because the hero waited on Google Fonts and started the H1 at opacity 0. Those paths are gone locally.

**Critical path**
- Lexend is self-hosted with `next/font`, same as Manrope. The Google stylesheet and preconnects are out of [`homepage/app/layout.tsx`](homepage/app/layout.tsx).
- The exported homepage preloads **three** local woff2 files and has **no** `fonts.googleapis.com`.

**Accessibility / agents**
- New `--color-accent-text` (`#b84018`) on kickers, labels, and small accent copy: **5.1–5.3:1** on paper and sky bands.
- Journey numbers use navy (`#345c7c`): **6.8:1**.
- [`relocation_jobs/static/llms.txt`](relocation_jobs/static/llms.txt) now has Markdown `[label](url)` links.

**Bundle**
- Homepage-only CSS lives in [`homepage/app/home.css`](homepage/app/home.css) (only `/` loads the second stylesheet).
- `SearchFlowProvider` wraps Hero + SearchResults only. Hero copy is a server component; search is a client island.
- Modern `browserslist` in [`homepage/package.json`](homepage/package.json). Unused `useInView` deleted.

Verified locally: homepage search still returns companies, `/how-it-works` still styles correctly, public API tests pass (20). This is in the Flask static export; **production `kuchup.com` will not change until you deploy.** After that, re-run the mobile PageSpeed report — target is Performance ≥ 90, Accessibility 100, Agentic 3/3.
